green: A green run: the easiest rating.
blue: A blue run: the middle rating.
black: A black run: a difficult rating.
dblack: A double-black run: the steepest rating, for experts.
open: Open: enough snow on 60 % of the run. The run scores in full.
patchy: Patchy: between open and closed. The run scores part of its value.
closed: Closed: snow on under 40 % of the run. The run scores nothing.
openpatchy: Open or patchy: a run that adds to the score.
school: Ski school: an active ski school adds 12 to the score while a green run is open or patchy.
lift: Lift: any lift type. A run needs a lift to score in full.
power: Power: the city's electricity. A lift without power stops.
snow: Snow: the depth and the cover of snow on the runs.
